verdict.rationale: Building custom AI agents is a fair question for a work-management SaaS that ships AI features, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents an in-product custom agent builder. The Rovo AI items describe using AI to create automation rules, assign tasks and surface trends, which are adjacent features rather than configurable agents. Rich APIs and the official MCP server are developer building blocks or belong to other stories, so they earn no credit here.
